summary: Keep collection snapshots responsive during bounded conversation admission using the existing owner inventory

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; snapshot and incarnation fencing are preserved.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. Agent session resolution and ownership reuse the existing incremental runtime identity inventory at the requested snapshot; known subjects select their entry directly and validate the managed-session hash, while opaque session IDs retain inventory-derived reversal.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Existing collection commands, conversation frames, session IDs, scopes and owner routing are unchanged. Pending admission and queued frames are fenced on replacement and unsubscribe.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption. Physical admission is bounded to eight lookups per socket and 32 process-wide, separately from collection reads. These are concurrency-only limits, with no lookup timeout or queue-wait duration bound.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required; identity and stored state are preserved.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions; schema and rules versions are unchanged.
